scope: Read all234 helper lines, savedJSON and source NPZ; independent NumPy algebra at three saved poses per subject. No OpenSim import, helper/main execution, FK, integration, IK solving or input changes. Only this assigned review JSON written.
checks: Local eight stations have affine rank2 and two duplicate pairs. Two non-collinear directions determine the mapped plane; detR=+1 fixes the cross-product normal, identifying a unique proper rotation. Rank3 is not required.
Column-vector convention center=Rlocal+p and covariance localCentered.T*worldCentered yield correct Kabsch R=Vdiag(1,1,sign(det(VU.T)))U.T.
Reconstruction of all8 centers, RᵀR≈I, det≈+1 and ordered-edge normal handedness are guarded and reported; no reflection is silently accepted.
Independent ordered-edge orthonormal basis recovers proper transforms at first/middle/last saved poses and reconstructs all8 centers within1e-12m.
NPZ hashes match both factorial exports and phase-audit provenance; arrays have finite increasing timestamps and frozen sphere order.
Signed depth identity radius+planeY−originY−(Rlocal07)Y is exact; shared radius/plane cancel from B-minus-A.
Twenty measured-HS→TO stance bins use the same native1ms+exactevent support and duration-weighted pooling as the phase budget; raw-depth bin means match.
Only scalar originY and rotated-pointY are interpolated at bin endpoints; no rotation-matrix interpolation or phase-warped principal timing score.
Positive penetration=max(raw,0) is stored separately and is not decomposed by separately clipping origin/orientation terms.
Signed-depth means add algebraically; shape variances require the reported covariance/cross term. Correlation is descriptive, not causal attribution.

Origin and orientation are complete prepared-pose factors, neither anatomy-only nor preparation-only; native mean-pose checks are correctly labeled as scalar checks, not archived full transform arrays.

critical_force_interpretation.warning: The raw late-bin difference is largely outside active sphere07 contact. It must not be multiplied by stiffness to infer extra force. Force uses smoothPositive(raw) after clipping/regularization, not the B-minus-A raw-depth difference. The roughly31mm raw difference corresponds to only about0.111mm difference of mean positive penetration in that bin.
critical_force_interpretation.additional_limit: A mean of a clipped/smoothed depth is not generally clipping/smoothing of the mean. Use the already computed phase/contact force integrals for force comparisons.
